note: Conceptual source/target systems. All SIMULATED — no real connectivity. Defines the mental model the domain assumes and the sample data seeds.

connectorTypes.name: HR System
connectorTypes.role: authoritative source for identities & lifecycle events

concepts.authoritativeSource: HR is the authoritative source of identities; the directory is authoritative for accounts. Governance flows FROM these sources.
concepts.provisioning: When a request is approved, provisioning WRITES the entitlement to the target app via its connector — simulated with realistic states (provisioning → fulfilled/failed).
concepts.reconciliation: Connectors periodically 'sync', which can surface orphan accounts and out-of-band changes — a source of governance findings.
